day_shape: 57 items: Iran-US MoU implementation moves to technical phase per Qatar, cargo ship struck off Oman per UKMTO, Israel-Lebanon withdrawal claims disputed by IDF officials, IDF reservist killed in southern Lebanon accident, heavy Ashura regime-channel cycle.

threads.label: Iran-US deal enters implementation phase
threads.summary: Qatar's Foreign Ministry spokesman said technical teams have begun work on details of implementing the Iran-US agreement, while Rubio heads to Bahrain to court Gulf support. Iranian MP Nabavian denounced the MoU on state TV, and Qalibaf rejected US claims that freed assets would buy American agricultural products.

threads.label: Lebanon withdrawal claims contested
threads.summary: A US State Department official said Israel withdrew from parts of Lebanese buffer zones as a 'good faith' step, but Israeli security officials denied the Reuters report and Defense Minister Katz said forces would remain in Lebanon, Syria and Gaza 'without any time limit.' IRIB cited a source claiming Israeli withdrawal from occupied Lebanese areas is a red line in final-agreement talks.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and Oman incident
threads.summary: UKMTO and Iranian state media reported a cargo ship struck by an unknown projectile 7.5 nautical miles south-east of Dhahat, Oman. Foreign Minister Araghchi said Iran and Oman agreed to talks on Strait of Hormuz management, while Iran International reported hardline Iranian objections to Oman's IMO-coordinated shipping corridor.

threads.label: IDF operations in Lebanon and Gaza
threads.summary: The IDF announced the death of Master Sgt. (res.) Basil Sweid, 32, in a refueling-truck accident in southern Lebanon's Rab al-Thalathine area. The IDF also said a Tuesday strike in Khan Younis killed Islamic Jihad weapons-production commander Adam Muhammad Ibrahim Abu Hadid.

threads.label: Ashura observances across regime channels
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press ran a heavy cycle of Ashura mourning content from Shiraz, Isfahan, Shahrood, Qom, Iraq's Samawa and Sana'a. Khamenei's office posted footage of Tasua and Ashura ceremonies beside the burial site of the 'martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution.'

events.title_en: A source close to the negotiating team told the Islamic Republic News Network that the Zionist regime's withdrawal from occupied areas of Lebanon is a condition of the final agreement
events.summary_en: A source close to the negotiating team told the Islamic Republic News Network that the Zionist regime's withdrawal from occupied areas of Lebanon is a condition of the final agreement and constitutes an important red line for Iran's team. The source continues: The final understanding memorandum guarantees Lebanon's sovereignty and territorial integrity. An issue which was emphasised in the single unified dispute resolution mechanism with Iran's participation in the Swiss text, and from Iran's side a timeline for its implementation is being pursued. The source finally stated: Over the past six days, the volume of attacks on Lebanon has decreased significantly, which indicates Iran's measures have been effective, but the Islamic Republic will not accept anything but a permanent ceasefire and the Zionist regime's complete withdrawal

events.source_detail: Times of Israel · military correspondent · X (via rss.app)
events.title: Speaking at an IDF cadets graduation ceremony, Defense Minister Israel Katz again says Israeli forces will remain inside security zones in Lebanon, Syria, and the Gaza Strip, "without any time limit." He says this is "to protect our residents and communities against jihadist elements." "We will not compromise on Israel's supreme security interest: protecting our soldiers and safeguarding our citizens, and we will not withdraw from the security zones," Katz says at the officers' school in southern Israel, known as Bahad 1. He also warns Tehran that if "Iran attacks Israel because of our actions in Lebanon, or for any other reason, we will strike it with full force."

events.summary_en: How beautiful it is to always see the joy of Lebanese youth! I know how difficult and concerning it was for them as they sat their exams in a tense atmosphere and amid a war imposed by Hezbollah on their homeland. Their joy today is not because of the exam cancellation in itself, but rather due to their lack of psychological and moral readiness. In their depths, and based on my knowledge of Lebanese youth's ambitions, they wanted to 'sit' the exam in order to continue the path of the future they desired to be prosperous, were it not for Hezbollah's terrorist decision to impose the logic of war on the values of progress and development.

events.title: Security Council, 10183rd Meeting (PM) UN Disengagement Observer Force
events.summary: At 3 p.m., the Security Council will vote on a draft resolution renewing the mandate of the UN Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF), which expires on 30 June. UNDOF was established following the 1974 Disengagement of Forces Agreement between Israel and Syria, which ended the Yom Kippur War. Its mandate is to maintain the ceasefire between the parties and supervise the disengagement of Israeli and Syrian forces, as well as the areas of separation and limitation in the Golan.

events.title: Agricultural Foreign Investment Disclosure Act of 1978
events.summary: The United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) is proposing to update its regulations regarding the Agricultural Foreign Investment Disclosure Act of 1978 (the AFIDA). The revisions would reflect Congressional directives to establish a streamlined process for electronic submission and retention of disclosures made under AFIDA, including the deployment of an internet database. It would also revise reporting requirements and strengthen enforcement measures. Through the implementation of modernization measures and expanded scope and depth of reporting, this proposed rule will help ensure the AFIDA regulations address foreign investment and ownership of American agricultural land, particularly as it might present a national security risk.
